changes: Setup progress now retries saving after connection problems, so you do not have to repeat onboarding on another device.
After your first conversation summary, Omi asks once if you are enjoying it, with a quick way to rate the app.
Fix the microphone staying on after leaving the voice-introduction step if you tapped Back or Skip right after Start Speaking.
If your pendant stays connected but audio stops arriving, Omi notices and tries to reconnect.
Review: a Dream Report for early testers showing what Omi's background cleanup looked at and would change
Phone calls are hidden in the app for now.
Fixes memories failing to load on very large accounts: a slow memory read now retries instead of showing your memories as empty.
Confirm your voice once per conversation, with answers applied only to the clip you played
Fix the pendant tutorial's Ask Omi a Question step getting stuck on "Processing your question" forever when you pressed twice without speaking or Omi didn't catch what you said.
Omi now asks once whether you are enjoying it when you open a conversation, with a quick way to rate the app.

changes.change: Long Apple Watch recordings no longer build up in your phone's memory, so the app is less likely to be closed partway through one

changes: Relabel as many speakers as you want in one pass: label lines, pick names with one tap, and update the summary once when you're done. Short transcript lines also stay left-aligned.
Chat app connections recognize every paid plan when enabled for your account.
Clearer descriptions for Pin, speaker confidence, notification frequency, and transcription settings
Review: approve or dismiss Omi's suggested cleanups, like closing a finished task or merging two people
Enjoy a cleaner recording screen and home header, with tappable speaker labels and storage alerts only when phone space is low or unavailable.
Prevent repeated Android sync keep-alive restarts for a 24-hour rolling window after its foreground-service time limit is reached, including after the app restarts.
